summary: The filing is a Form 8-K Item 8.01 other events notice from Vista Credit Strategic Lending Corp. announcing a monthly distribution for April 2026. The company declared a gross distribution of $0.16000 per share for Class I and Class S common stock, with a net distribution of $0.16000 for Class I and $0.14652 for Class S after shareholder servicing fees. The record date was April 30, 2026, and payment will occur on or about May 27, 2026, in cash or reinvested shares. There are no special situation elements such as M&A, activist campaign, or restructuring.
